description: Phase 47 — Production Wiring of Phase 46 Entry Filtering Modules. Wire all 5 Phase 46 standalone modules into the live trading pipeline: (1) MTF confluence into _evaluate_multi_timeframe(), (2) ensemble conflict resolver into _evaluate_uncertainty(), (3) session detector into execution.py and _team.py, (4) expectancy tracker into sync_closed_trades_rl() and agent weight updates, (5) regime gates position multiplier into calculate_position_size(). Plus: adaptive R:R ratio per regime. Target: 38% → 45% win rate.

userStories.title: Wire MTF Confluence into _evaluate_multi_timeframe()
userStories.description: Replace the synthetic H4/D1 approximation in _evaluate_multi_timeframe() with the Elder Triple Screen MultiTimeframeConfluence module. Lazy-init MultiTimeframeConfluence in ScannerAgentTeam.__init__(). In _evaluate_multi_timeframe(), call score_confluence() with available data and use confluence_score and direction_aligned to set the agent verdict. Fallback to existing logic if MTF module raises.

userStories.title: Wire Expectancy Tracker into RL Feedback Loop

In ScannerAgentTeam.evaluate(), apply expectancy-based weight modifiers (negative expectancy agents get -20% weight penalty). Persist expectancy state atomically.

userStories.title: Wire Regime Gates Position Multiplier into Position Sizing
userStories.description: The regime gates module provides a position_size_multiplier per regime (LOW=1.3, NORMAL=1.0, HIGH=0.65, EXTREME=0.40). Wire this multiplier into calculate_position_size() in execution.py, applied after adaptive sizing and before session multiplier. This creates a sizing chain: base → adaptive → regime → session → EWMA diversification.
